nodes.html: Page Reader  by ADC

Meet Page Reader, the first text-to-speech widget for LumApps. Give employees an easier way to consume content: Page Reader reads any LumApps page aloud, on desktop or mobile. It runs entirely in the user's browser, with no AI services and no third-party data sharing, so your content stays private and secure.
